paragraphs.source_en: “We cannot go any farther? Can it be that the enemy has already circled around ahead of us?”

units.source_en: “We cannot go any farther?
units.source_zh: “不能往前走了？

units.source_en: Can it be that the enemy has already circled around ahead of us?”
units.source_zh: 难道敌人已经绕到前面去了不成？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不能往前走了？难道敌人已经绕到前面去了不成？”

paragraphs.source_en: “I would not dare speak rashly, my lord. Please look at the banners among those trees. Those are clearly Oyamada’s men. They mean to drive us from the mountaintop into the valley to the north…”

units.source_en: “I would not dare speak rashly, my lord. Please look at the banners among those trees.
units.source_zh: “在下不敢妄言，主公请看那边树林间的旗幡。

units.source_en: Those are clearly Oyamada’s men. They mean to drive us from the mountaintop into the valley to the north…”
units.source_zh: 那分明是小山田的手下，想从山顶上把我们驱往北边的山谷……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下不敢妄言，主公请看那边树林间的旗幡。那分明是小山田的手下，想从山顶上把我们驱往北边的山谷……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Then it seems the rumor was true after all…”

units.source_en: “Then it seems the rumor was true after all…”
units.source_zh: “如此看来，那传闻果然属实……”

paragraphs.source_en: Startled by the sudden voice, Katsuyori looked up and heard a tumult of men in the grass atop the mountain; then more than a dozen arrows came flying toward them. Only then did Katsuyori understand that his hour of death had come.

units.source_en: Startled by the sudden voice, Katsuyori looked up and heard a tumult of men in the grass atop the mountain; then more than a dozen arrows came flying toward them.
units.source_zh: 突然听见有人说话，胜赖大吃一惊，抬头一看，只听山顶的草丛里人声鼎沸，接着，十多支箭射了过来。

units.source_en: Only then did Katsuyori understand that his hour of death had come.
units.source_zh: 胜赖这时才明白，自己的死期已到。

paragraphs.source_zh: 突然听见有人说话，胜赖大吃一惊，抬头一看，只听山顶的草丛里人声鼎沸，接着，十多支箭射了过来。胜赖这时才明白，自己的死期已到。

paragraphs.source_en: “If we continue this way, we shall be walking straight into the tiger’s jaws. Masatsugu, Sōzō, turn back at once and take the women with you.”

units.source_en: “If we continue this way, we shall be walking straight into the tiger’s jaws.
units.source_zh: “再这么走下去，就等于往虎口里送。

units.source_en: Masatsugu, Sōzō, turn back at once and take the women with you.”
units.source_zh: 昌次、总藏，赶快掉转方向，带着女人们撤回。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “再这么走下去，就等于往虎口里送。昌次、总藏，赶快掉转方向，带着女人们撤回。”

units.source_en: “And what of you, my lord?”
units.source_zh: “那您呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “This is the final struggle. I shall tear Oyamada’s head from his shoulders and cut him to pieces.”

units.source_en: “This is the final struggle.
units.source_zh: “这已经是最后一搏了。

units.source_en: I shall tear Oyamada’s head from his shoulders and cut him to pieces.”
units.source_zh: 我定要把小山田的脑袋揪下来，将他千刀万剐。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这已经是最后一搏了。我定要把小山田的脑袋揪下来，将他千刀万剐。”

paragraphs.source_en: At that very moment, Nagasaka Nyūdō Chōkan was also hurrying up from the rear to report grave news. “My lord, the vanguard of Oda Nobutada is pursuing us from behind and has already drawn close to this mountain. There is not a moment to lose. Roll up the banners at once and take refuge down the mountain.”

units.source_en: At that very moment, Nagasaka Nyūdō Chōkan was also hurrying up from the rear to report grave news.
units.source_zh: 其实，这时候，长坂入道钓闲也正在从后面赶来报告危情。

units.source_en: “My lord, the vanguard of Oda Nobutada is pursuing us from behind and has already drawn close to this mountain.
units.source_zh: “主公，织田信忠前锋从后面追来，已经逼近此山了。

units.source_en: There is not a moment to lose. Roll up the banners at once and take refuge down the mountain.”

ja.t: もございません。すぐに

units.source_zh: 刻不容缓，赶紧把旗子卷起来，下山避一避吧。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，这时候，长坂入道钓闲也正在从后面赶来报告危情。“主公，织田信忠前锋从后面追来，已经逼近此山了。刻不容缓，赶紧把旗子卷起来，下山避一避吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: At these words, Katsuyori sprang down from his horse and raised his face to heaven with a deep sigh.

units.source_en: At these words, Katsuyori sprang down from his horse and raised his face to heaven with a deep sigh.
units.source_zh: 胜赖听了，不禁从马上跳了下来，仰天长叹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖听了，不禁从马上跳了下来，仰天长叹。

paragraphs.source_en: The company was now a pitiful sight. It was neither an army nor a band of high-spirited warriors, but nothing more than a crowd of homeless refugees. The women joined hands and plunged into the dense bamboo grove, while only a few men with wives and children remained behind to guard the rear.

units.source_en: The company was now a pitiful sight. It was neither an army nor a band of high-spirited warriors, but nothing more than a crowd of homeless refugees.
units.source_zh: 一行人已经惨不忍睹，既不是一支军队，也不是一队昂扬之师，完全成了一群无家可归的难民。

units.source_en: The women joined hands and plunged into the dense bamboo grove, while only a few men with wives and children remained behind to guard the rear.
units.source_zh: 女人们手拉着手钻进了茂密的竹林，只有少数几个有家小的男人断后。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一行人已经惨不忍睹，既不是一支军队，也不是一队昂扬之师，完全成了一群无家可归的难民。女人们手拉着手钻进了茂密的竹林，只有少数几个有家小的男人断后。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori, Tarō Nobukatsu, Tsuchiya Masatsugu, Tsuchiya Sōzō, Nagasaka Chōkan, and the others had now become fierce-eyed hounds guarding the women’s flight to safety.

units.source_en: Katsuyori, Tarō Nobukatsu, Tsuchiya Masatsugu, Tsuchiya Sōzō, Nagasaka Chōkan, and the others had now become fierce-eyed hounds guarding the women’s flight to safety.
units.source_zh: 胜赖、太郎信胜、土屋昌次、土屋总藏，以及长坂钓闲诸人，如今竟成了掩护女人们逃生的、眼放凶光的狗。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖、太郎信胜、土屋昌次、土屋总藏，以及长坂钓闲诸人，如今竟成了掩护女人们逃生的、眼放凶光的狗。

paragraphs.source_en: They walked on without closing their eyes even once through the following day, and by the third day, when they finally felt their way to the foot of Mount Tenmoku’s southern slope, every one of them was scarcely recognizable.

units.source_en: They walked on without closing their eyes even once through the following day, and by the third day, when they finally felt their way to the foot of Mount Tenmoku’s southern slope, every one of them was scarcely recognizable.
units.source_zh: 直至次日，人们连眼皮都没有合一下，不停地往前走，到了第三天，等摸到天目山南麓山脚的时候，所有人都已面目全非了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 直至次日，人们连眼皮都没有合一下，不停地往前走，到了第三天，等摸到天目山南麓山脚的时候，所有人都已面目全非了。

paragraphs.source_en: Mount Tenmoku lies in Higashiyamanashi District and was originally called Mount Tokusa. When the monk Gakkai Honjō journeyed to the Great Yuan realm in search of Buddhist teachings, he visited Mount Tianmu there; after returning home, he built the Rinzai temple Seiunji on this spot, and so people came to call it Mount Tenmoku as well.

units.source_en: Mount Tenmoku lies in Higashiyamanashi District and was originally called Mount Tokusa. When the monk Gakkai Honjō journeyed to the Great Yuan realm in search of Buddhist teachings, he visited Mount Tianmu there; after returning home, he built the Rinzai temple Seiunji on this spot, and so people came to call it Mount Tenmoku as well.

ja.t: ばれるようになったのである。

units.source_zh: 天目山位于东山梨郡，原名木贼山，只因业海本净和尚去大元朝取经时，拜谒了天目山，回国后，就在这里修建了临济宗栖云寺，于是人亦称此地为天目山。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天目山位于东山梨郡，原名木贼山，只因业海本净和尚去大元朝取经时，拜谒了天目山，回国后，就在这里修建了临济宗栖云寺，于是人亦称此地为天目山。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time the company reached the grasslands of Tano Village south of Mount Tenmoku, only forty-one men remained, and the women numbered fewer than fifty. Tsuchiya Masatsugu’s five-year-old son refused to walk another step. He dropped down on the grass and would not rise no matter what anyone said, so they had no choice but to halt there.

units.source_en: By the time the company reached the grasslands of Tano Village south of Mount Tenmoku, only forty-one men remained, and the women numbered fewer than fifty.
units.source_zh: 当一行人走到天目山南面的田野村草原时，男的只剩四十一人，女的已经不到五十人了。

units.source_en: Tsuchiya Masatsugu’s five-year-old son refused to walk another step. He dropped down on the grass and would not rise no matter what anyone said, so they had no choice but to halt there.

ja.t: とうとしなかった。やむなく

units.source_zh: 土屋昌次五岁的儿子不愿再走，一屁股坐到草地上，怎么也不肯起来，没有办法，大家只好在这里停了下来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当一行人走到天目山南面的田野村草原时，男的只剩四十一人，女的已经不到五十人了。土屋昌次五岁的儿子不愿再走，一屁股坐到草地上，怎么也不肯起来，没有办法，大家只好在这里停了下来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Be good now. Walk just a little farther.”

units.source_en: “Be good now. Walk just a little farther.”
units.source_zh: “乖，要做个好孩子，再走一会儿。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “乖，要做个好孩子，再走一会儿。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Let us rest here for a while.” The speaker was Lady Odawara, who before had smiled whenever their eyes met, but who now hardly uttered a word.

units.source_en: “Let us rest here for a while.”
units.source_zh: “先在这里休息一会儿吧。”

units.source_en: The speaker was Lady Odawara, who before had smiled whenever their eyes met, but who now hardly uttered a word.
units.source_zh: 说话的正是之前与他目光一碰就微笑的、而现在却几乎一句话都不说的小田原夫人。

paragraphs.source_zh: “先在这里休息一会儿吧。”说话的正是之前与他目光一碰就微笑的、而现在却几乎一句话都不说的小田原夫人。

paragraphs.source_en: “You must be weary too, my lady?”

units.source_en: “You must be weary too, my lady?”
units.source_zh: “夫人也累了吧？”

paragraphs.source_en: The sky was a deep, flawless blue, and warm sunlight bathed the earth.

units.source_en: The sky was a deep, flawless blue, and warm sunlight bathed the earth.
units.source_zh: 天空湛蓝湛蓝的，暖洋洋的日光洒满了大地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天空湛蓝湛蓝的，暖洋洋的日光洒满了大地。
